Console字号需在10–24之间: Console font size must be between 10 and 24
Console行距需在1–1.8之间: Console line spacing must be between 1 and 1.8
DevStart启动配置已被外部修改，请先重新读取启动脚本:: Launch configuration changed externally. Refresh launch scripts first:
仅显示包含关键词的日志行: Show only log lines containing the keyword
仅显示最近输出；日志文件也有保留上限: Recent output only; log files also have retention limits
保留原脚本文件和日志。: The source file and logs will be kept.
关闭搜索，恢复完整视图: Close search and restore the full view
分组名称不能包含换行或控制字符: Group name cannot contain line breaks or control characters
启动文件有未保存的编辑，请先保存或关闭再删除/变更源文件: Save or close the unsaved launch file before deleting it or changing its source
回退会保留当前版本，下次启动使用回退后的文件。: The current version will be kept. The next launch will use the restored file.
在当前保留的最近日志中搜索，按 Enter / Shift+Enter 跳转: Search retained output; use Enter / Shift+Enter to navigate
在标签视图中打开当前 Console: Open this console in a tab
已运行，可停止或重启: Already running; stop or restart it
应用菜单必须在主线程创建: The application menu must be created on the main thread
当前图形后端不支持独立 Console 窗口: Detached console windows are not supported by this graphics backend
文件已关闭，可从左侧历史重新打开: File closed. Reopen it from the sidebar history.
文件已被外部修改；请重新载入，当前草稿仍保留: The file changed externally. Reload it; your draft has been kept.
文件有未保存修改，请先保存或明确放弃: This file has unsaved changes. Save or discard them first.
无法静态确定启动端口，且尚未确认实际监听；可在启动清单中声明 expected_: No configured port or confirmed listener; declare expected_port in the launch configuration
是否停止并关闭？: Stop this launch and close the tab?
显示名需要 1–50 个字符，且不能包含换行或控制字符: Display name must contain 1–50 characters without line breaks or control characters
有启动文件尚未保存。: Some launch files have unsaved changes.
欢迎提出建议，也欢迎捐赠支持。: Your feedback and donations are welcome.
界面字号需在10–18之间: Interface font size must be between 10 and 18
相同命令和参数的启动项已存在: A launch with the same command and arguments already exists
系统应用菜单尚未创建: The system application menu is not ready
调整工作台和 Console 的阅读体验: Customize the workspace and console reading experience
选择一个启动文件开始编辑: Choose a launch file to start editing
配置仍有运行实例，请先停止并确认退出: This configuration has a running instance. Stop it and wait for it to exit first.
项目名称不能包含换行或控制字符: Project name cannot contain line breaks or control characters
默认分组不可删除: The default group cannot be deleted
切换会更新整个仓库的文件，关联项目也会受到影响。请先停止依赖这些文件的服务；有未: Switching updates files throughout the repository, including associated projects. Stop services that depend on these files first. Uncommitted changes will prevent switching.
在当前仓库执行 Git 命令，不支持 shell 管道。: Runs Git in this repository. Shell pipelines are not supported.
恢复到 HEAD，覆盖此文件的工作区和暂存区改动。DevStart 会先保存备份: Restore this file to HEAD, replacing its working tree and staged changes. DevStart saves a backup first.
将本地提交推送到当前分支配置的远程上游，不强制覆盖。: Push local commits to the configured upstream without force.
拉取远程更新并合并到当前分支。发生冲突时保留冲突供手动处理。: Fetch and merge into the current branch. Conflicts remain available for manual resolution.
从当前远程仓库当前分支获取最新版本与本地合并代码: Fetch the latest version of the current branch from the selected remote and merge it into the local branch.
将本地提交推送到所选远程仓库的当前分支，不强制覆盖。: Push local commits to the current branch of the selected remote without force.
合并提交：相对第一父提交: Merge commit: compared with its first parent
初始提交：相对空目录: Initial commit: compared with the empty tree
相对父提交的改动: Changes compared with the parent commit
双击文件查看本次提交的差异: Double-click a file to view this commit’s diff
本次提交没有文件改动: This commit has no file changes
切换后，更新和推送将使用所选地址。此操作不修改 Git 远程配置。: Updates and pushes will use the selected address. Git remote configuration is unchanged.
适合 AI Coding 时代的多项目启动工作台。: A multi-project launch workbench for the AI Coding era.
需要相关服务时，找到对应项目、点击启动，再切回当前项目。项目依赖与启动顺序由你掌: Need a related service? Find its project, click to start it, then switch back. You choose the dependencies and launch order.
项目多也不乱。快速找到项目，启动、停止、看日志，再切回手头的工作。: More projects. Less friction. Find a project, start or stop it, check its logs, and get back to your work.

自动扫描识别项目与启动项: Automatically discover projects and launch entries
